decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing builds directly on the firm's core drainage engineering knowledge, and it has its own product page, so the firm can interpret early market feedback and refine it.

Floor-level shower drainage is the drainage specialist's core competence, so the firm has strong related knowledge to assimilate results and improve the system, although the product is only mentioned on the website.
A designer shower drain combines the firm's established drain technology with design variation, which its existing knowledge base can handle, and it is presented prominently on its own page.

A shower element with integrated slope is somewhat further from metal drain fabrication, but it remains closely tied to the firm's shower drainage systems, so it is worth keeping while the firm learns from early results.
The backflow-protected basement drain was developed in-house, as the website's launch statement says, and has a dedicated page, which shows strong absorptive capacity and commitment.

An air-admittance valve is a related drainage-ventilation component that fits the firm's plumbing knowledge, though its weaker web presence suggests it is a lower priority that still complements the product range.
